name: test_missing_file_is_fetched_and_placed
expected_result: A recorded file not on disk ends up under its final name with the bytes the server sent, and the run exits 0.

name: test_fetched_file_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After a file is fetched and placed, nothing is left under its .part name.

name: test_fetch_is_reported
expected_result: The report names the file as fetching and counts it as fetched.

name: test_present_matching_file_is_not_fetched
expected_result: A file already on disk that matches its entry is not downloaded, and the run exits 0.

name: test_present_matching_file_is_counted_as_present
expected_result: The report counts a matching file as present and fetches nothing.

name: test_dry_run_names_each_file_it_would_fetch
expected_result: With the dry-run option, each missing file is named as one the run would fetch, and they are counted.

name: test_dry_run_touches_neither_network_nor_disk
expected_result: With the dry-run option, nothing is downloaded and nothing is written.

name: test_dry_run_exits_8_when_a_file_is_missing
expected_result: With the dry-run option, the run exits 8 when at least one file would need fetching, because a pinned file has not been downloaded.

name: test_dry_run_exits_0_when_the_corpus_is_complete
expected_result: With the dry-run option, the run exits 0 when every file is present and matching, so a quiet dry run answers whether the pinned files are complete from the exit code alone.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing at all is printed, even when a file is fetched.

name: test_set_fetches_only_that_manifests_files
expected_result: With the set option naming one manifest, only that manifest's files are fetched.

name: test_set_does_not_read_the_other_manifests
expected_result: With the set option, a manifest that was not named is not read at all, so an unreadable one does not stop the run.

name: test_changed_file_is_reported_as_a_mismatch
expected_result: A file on disk that no longer matches its entry is reported as a mismatch on its fingerprint, and as left alone.

name: test_changed_file_is_left_alone
expected_result: A changed file is neither replaced nor deleted, and its bytes are as they were.

name: test_changed_file_exits_9
expected_result: A changed file on disk makes the run exit 9, and the summary says a person has to look.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_is_discarded
expected_result: A download whose bytes do not match the entry is reported as discarded, and it is under neither its final name nor its temporary name.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_exits_12
expected_result: A discarded download makes the run exit 12 and is counted as a failed fetch.

name: test_failed_fetch_exits_11_with_its_cause
expected_result: An address that cannot be fetched makes the run exit 11, and it is reported as failed, with the cause.

name: test_failure_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and another that cannot be fetched, both are reported and the exit code is 11, because a missing file is worse than a changed one.

name: test_dry_run_missing_file_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: In a dry run too, a file that would need fetching outranks a changed file. Both are reported and the exit code is 8, not 9.

name: test_wrong_hash_download_outranks_disagreement
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and another whose download does not match its entry, both are reported and the exit code is 12, not 9. A file still missing is worse than a changed one.

name: test_failed_fetch_outranks_a_discarded_download
expected_result: With one file that cannot be fetched and another whose download does not match its entry, both are reported and the exit code is 11, not 12. A file nothing could be downloaded for is worse.

name: test_disagreement_outranks_an_unreadable_file
expected_result: With one file changed on disk and a folder where another file should be, both are reported and the exit code is 9, not 13.

name: test_locked_file_exits_13_reported_as_cannot_read
expected_result: A recorded file that cannot be opened makes the run exit 13 rather than end with a Python error, and it is reported as unreadable with the cause, and as left alone.

name: test_folder_at_a_recorded_path_exits_13_reported_as_cannot_read
expected_result: A folder where a recorded file should be makes the run exit 13, and it is reported as unreadable, a folder not a file, and as left alone.

name: test_entry_missing_a_field_exits_3_naming_the_field
expected_result: An entry lacking a required field stops the run with exit 3, and the message names the field.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_exits_3_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON stops the run with exit 3, and the message names the file.

name: test_unknown_set_exits_3_naming_it
expected_result: With the set option naming a manifest that does not exist, the run exits 3 and the message names it.

name: test_not_in_repo_exits_6_with_the_install_command
expected_result: The sdg package, when not running from inside its repo, exits 6, and the message gives the install command.

name: test_repo_check_runs_before_any_manifest_is_read
expected_result: With a wrong package name and an unreadable manifest, the run exits 6 and not 3, which shows the repo check came first.

name: test_a_location_outside_inputs_exits_66
expected_result: An entry whose location does not stay under inputs/ stops the run with exit 66 before anything is fetched, and the message quotes the location.

name: test_download_holds_the_bytes_the_server_sent
expected_result: The .part file holds exactly the bytes the server sent, in order.

name: test_download_is_written_under_the_part_name
expected_result: A completed download is written to <destination>.part, and that path is handed back.

name: test_nothing_appears_under_the_final_name
expected_result: A completed download does not create the final name, because placing the file is a separate step.

name: test_missing_folders_are_created
expected_result: The folders on the way to the destination are created when they do not exist.

name: test_leftover_part_file_is_replaced
expected_result: A .part file left by an earlier run is replaced by the new download, not added to.

name: test_request_is_a_get_on_the_given_url
expected_result: The download asks the server for the address it was given.

name: test_request_asks_to_follow_redirects
expected_result: The download follows a redirect, so a file the server has moved is still found.

name: test_request_carries_the_module_timeout
expected_result: The download gives up after the number of seconds the download step sets.

name: test_partial_path_adds_part_to_the_file_name
expected_result: The temporary name adds .part to the file name and keeps the folder.

name: test_error_status_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_status
expected_result: A server that answers with an error status makes the download fail, and the message names the address and the status.

name: test_error_status_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After an error status, no .part file is left on disk, not even one an earlier run left behind.

name: test_unreachable_server_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_cause
expected_result: A connection that cannot be made makes the download fail, and the message names the address and the cause.

name: test_unreachable_server_leaves_no_part_file
expected_result: After a failed connection, no .part file is left on disk, not even one an earlier run left behind.

name: test_unparseable_url_raises_fetch_error_naming_url_and_cause
expected_result: An address the download cannot parse makes it fail with a message naming the address and the cause, so acquire_sources counts it and carries on. No .part file is left, not even one an earlier run left behind.

name: test_file_where_the_folder_should_be_raises_fetch_error
expected_result: A plain file sitting where the destination's folder should be makes the download fail with a message naming the address, and the file is left as it was.

name: test_a_failed_cleanup_does_not_mask_the_fetch_error
expected_result: When the .part file cannot be removed after a failed download, the error reported is the download's, not the removal's.

name: test_broken_transfer_raises_fetch_error_naming_the_cause
expected_result: A transfer that breaks after the first piece makes the download fail, and the message names the cause.

name: test_broken_transfer_removes_the_half_written_part_file
expected_result: After a transfer breaks part way, the half-written .part file is removed, so it cannot be mistaken for a finished download.

name: test_place_puts_the_file_under_its_final_name
expected_result: After a file is placed, its bytes are at the final name.

name: test_place_hands_back_the_final_path
expected_result: Placing a file gives back its final path.

name: test_place_removes_the_part_name
expected_result: After a file is placed, nothing is left under its .part name.

name: test_discard_deletes_the_part_file
expected_result: Discarding a .part file deletes it and gives back nothing.

name: test_place_refuses_when_the_final_name_is_taken
expected_result: When a file already sits at the final name, placing is refused. The message names that file and says to run acquire_sources again after dealing with it.

name: test_refused_place_leaves_the_existing_file_untouched
expected_result: When placing a download is refused because a file is already at the final name, that file keeps its bytes.

name: test_refused_place_leaves_the_part_file_where_it_was
expected_result: When placing a download is refused because a file is already at the final name, the .part file stays where it was, with its bytes.

name: test_place_refuses_a_missing_part_file
expected_result: Placing a .part file that does not exist is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_place_refuses_a_name_without_the_part_suffix
expected_result: Placing a file whose name does not end in .part is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_place_leaves_a_file_it_refused_untouched
expected_result: A file refused for its name when placing keeps its bytes.

name: test_discard_refuses_a_missing_part_file
expected_result: Discarding a .part file that does not exist is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_discard_refuses_a_name_without_the_part_suffix
expected_result: Discarding a file whose name does not end in .part is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_discard_leaves_a_file_it_refused_in_place
expected_result: A file refused for its name when discarding is not deleted, so a pinned file can never be discarded by mistake.

name: test_fingerprint_measures_the_size
expected_result: A file's fingerprint gives its size in bytes.

name: test_fingerprint_measures_the_sha256
expected_result: A file's fingerprint is the same as one worked out separately from the same bytes.

name: test_reading_in_pieces_loses_nothing
expected_result: A file bigger than the piece read at a time has the same fingerprint as one worked out from the whole file.

name: test_matching_file_compares_as_matched
expected_result: A file whose size and fingerprint equal its entry's compares as matched.

name: test_size_difference_is_reported_with_both_numbers
expected_result: When the size differs from the entry, the result is not matched and the detail gives the file's size and the manifest's.

name: test_size_difference_skips_the_hash
expected_result: When the size differs, the fingerprint is not worked out at all.

name: test_same_size_different_bytes_is_reported_as_sha256_difference
expected_result: When the size matches but the bytes differ, the result is not matched, and the detail shows the start of both fingerprints.

name: test_fingerprint_refuses_a_missing_file
expected_result: Working out the fingerprint of a file that does not exist is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_compare_refuses_a_missing_file
expected_result: Comparing a file that does not exist is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_fingerprint_refuses_a_folder
expected_result: Working out a fingerprint where a folder sits is refused, and the message names the path, because only a file can be measured.

name: test_compare_refuses_a_folder
expected_result: Comparing where a folder sits is refused, and the message names the path.

name: test_every_manifest_lands_under_inputs
expected_result: Every real manifest, wherever it sits under manifests/, says its files land under inputs/.

name: test_every_entry_carries_the_five_required_fields
expected_result: Every entry in every real manifest has a name, an address, a local path under inputs/ that never steps back up a folder, a size above zero and a well-formed fingerprint.

name: test_repo_root_is_the_folder_holding_pyproject
expected_result: The repo root found is the folder that holds pyproject.toml.

name: test_every_entry_names_the_manifest_it_came_from
expected_result: Every entry remembers which manifest file it was read from.

name: test_study_manifest_is_read_with_the_top_level_ones
expected_result: A manifest under manifests/study_documents/ is read along with the top-level manifests.

name: test_study_manifests_are_listed_after_the_top_level_ones
expected_result: The study manifests come after the top-level ones in the list.

name: test_manifests_are_listed_in_path_order
expected_result: Manifests come back sorted by path, whatever order they were written in.

name: test_one_manifest_can_be_read_by_name
expected_result: Asking for a manifest by name gives only that one.

name: test_the_name_may_carry_the_json_suffix
expected_result: Asking by the file name with its .json suffix gives that same one manifest.

name: test_entry_for_finds_a_recorded_file
expected_result: Given the path a manifest writes, the entry that records that file is found.

name: test_entry_for_accepts_backslashes
expected_result: A repo-relative path written with backslashes finds the same entry.

name: test_entry_for_accepts_a_full_path
expected_result: A full Path to the file finds the same entry.

name: test_entry_path_is_the_file_on_this_machine
expected_result: An entry's path is the full path of its file on this machine.

name: test_entry_for_gives_none_for_an_unrecorded_file
expected_result: A file that no manifest records gives None, not an error.

name: test_entry_named_finds_a_recorded_file_by_its_name
expected_result: Given a file name, the entry for that file is found, so a caller holding only the name never writes the path down a second time.

name: test_entry_named_gives_none_for_a_name_no_manifest_records
expected_result: A file name that no manifest records finds nothing, and is not an error.

name: test_a_relative_path_is_read_from_the_repo_root
expected_result: A relative Path finds the same entry as the repo-relative string, whichever folder the program was started from, so a command run from elsewhere never reports a recorded file as unrecorded.

name: test_as_local_leaves_an_outside_path_unchanged
expected_result: A path outside the repo is shown as its full path, so a message about it can show where it is.

name: test_wrong_package_name_is_refused_with_the_install_command
expected_result: When pyproject.toml does not name the sdg package, reading the manifests is refused, and the message gives the command to install from the repo.

name: test_repo_check_runs_before_any_manifest_is_read
expected_result: With a wrong package name and an unreadable manifest, the error is about the sdg package, which shows the repo check came first.

name: test_missing_manifests_folder_is_named_with_the_restore_remedy
expected_result: When manifests/ is missing, the error names the folder and says to restore it with git.

name: test_empty_manifests_folder_is_reported_as_none_found
expected_result: When manifests/ holds no manifest, the error says none were found and says to restore them with git.

name: test_unknown_manifest_name_is_refused_by_name
expected_result: Asking for a manifest by a name no file has gives an error that quotes the name.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_stops_the_read_and_names_the_file
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON stops the whole read, even when another manifest is fine. The message names the bad file and says to restore it from git.

name: test_manifest_that_is_a_list_is_refused_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest whose JSON is a list rather than an object is refused as unreadable. The message names the file and says to restore it from git.

name: test_entry_that_is_not_an_object_is_refused_naming_the_file
expected_result: A manifest whose files list holds a bare value rather than an entry object is refused as unreadable, naming the file and the git restore remedy.

name: test_entry_missing_fields_has_every_missing_field_named
expected_result: An entry lacking required fields is refused with one message that names the manifest, the entry, every missing field, and the repair remedy.

name: test_size_that_is_not_a_whole_number_is_quoted_as_written
expected_result: A size written as "12,345" is refused as not a whole number, quoting the value as written, with the repair remedy.

name: test_sha256_that_is_not_lowercase_hex_is_quoted_as_written
expected_result: A fingerprint written in capitals is refused as not well formed, and the message quotes it as written and says how to repair it.

name: test_a_name_two_entries_record_is_refused_naming_both
expected_result: A file name that two entries record is refused rather than answered with either one. The message names the location of both, says the two pinned files share the name, and says the code asking for it has to choose one version.

name: test_a_location_that_leaves_inputs_is_refused
expected_result: An entry whose local location does not stay under inputs/ once resolved is refused, and the message quotes the location and says how to write it. It runs once for a location opening with a slash, which replaces the repo root, and once for one that steps back out of inputs/ with .., which the first four characters alone would let through.

name: test_pinned_file_is_unchanged
expected_result: A pinned file on disk has the size and fingerprint its manifest entry records, so it is unchanged since it was pinned. It runs once for each file the manifests record.

name: test_recorded_file_carries_its_identity
expected_result: A file whose entry is correct comes back with the fingerprint, address and manifest name its entry records.

name: test_recorded_file_path_is_the_file_on_this_machine
expected_result: A verified file's path is the full path of the file on this machine, and its local path is the one the manifest writes.

name: test_recorded_file_content_reads
expected_result: A verified file's content can be read.

name: test_staged_record_is_the_same_by_string_or_path
expected_result: The repo-relative string a manifest writes, the same string with backslashes, and a full Path all give the same record.

name: test_not_in_repo_error_passes_through_unwrapped
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, verifying a file is refused with the install command, not reported as a mismatch.

name: test_recorded_but_absent_file_raises_file_not_found
expected_result: A file a manifest records that is not on disk is refused as missing, and the message names the path. That is a different failure from a file that cannot be verified.

name: test_locked_file_passes_the_operating_systems_error_through
expected_result: A recorded file on disk that cannot be opened is refused as not permitted, and the message names the path. It is not reported as a mismatch or a missing file.

name: test_unrecorded_file_is_refused_as_unrecorded
expected_result: A file that no manifest records is refused with a message saying so and the remedy of adding an entry.

name: test_unrecorded_file_does_not_get_the_mismatch_remedy
expected_result: The message for an unrecorded file does not carry the mismatch remedy, which would send a person to re-download a file that was never recorded.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_is_reported_as_a_manifest_problem
expected_result: A manifest that cannot be read is reported with the manifest reader's own message, naming the manifest file and saying to restore it from git.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_does_not_get_the_mismatch_remedy
expected_result: The message for an unreadable manifest does not carry the mismatch remedy, because the file is not the problem.

name: test_no_manifests_is_reported_as_none_found
expected_result: When the manifests folder is empty, the refusal says no manifests were found and says to restore them with git.

name: test_entry_missing_sha256_is_reported_as_lacking_it
expected_result: An entry with no fingerprint is refused as missing that field, and the message says to repair the entry rather than download the file again.

name: test_mismatch_shows_both_sha256_values
expected_result: When a file is the right size but its contents differ from its record, the message shows the start of both fingerprints.

name: test_mismatch_names_the_manifest_that_records_the_file
expected_result: The mismatch message names the manifest the file is recorded in.

name: test_mismatch_offers_the_three_ways_back
expected_result: The mismatch message offers three ways back. They are to fetch the file again, read it once unverified, or pin it again.

name: test_size_mismatch_is_reported_as_size_with_both_numbers
expected_result: When the size differs from the entry, the refusal reports a size difference with the file's size and the manifest's.

name: test_unreadable_manifests_make_the_stability_check_fail_once
expected_result: When the manifests cannot be read, the stability check runs once and fails with the manifest reader's own message, so a broken manifest can never leave the check running zero times and passing quietly.

name: test_pinned_file_is_shaped_the_way_the_loader_expects
expected_result: The pinned USDM model file passes the loader's two shape tests, so what the loader expects of USDM v4 matches the real file. The file is read without its fingerprint being confirmed, which the stability check covers.

name: test_pinned_file_types_are_classes_or_five_primitives
expected_result: Every attribute type in the pinned model is a class in the model or one of the five basic types, and exactly four attributes point at more than one type. The check holds its own copy of the five and the four.

name: test_fixture_classes_are_identical_to_pinned
expected_result: Each class in the small fixture file matches the same class in the pinned model entry for entry, so the checks that ran on the fixture ran on real USDM shapes.

name: test_lists_every_class_sorted
expected_result: A well-formed file loads, and its classes are listed in alphabetical order, so a listing is the same from run to run.

name: test_abstract_flag_comes_from_modifier
expected_result: Whether a class is abstract comes from USDM's own Modifier field. So Identifier, a parent never used on its own, is abstract, and StudyIdentifier, its child, is not.

name: test_attributes_keep_file_order_and_inheritance
expected_result: A class's attributes come back in the order the file lists them, including the ones it takes from its parent, and each inherited one still names that parent.

name: test_targets_unwraps_one_and_many
expected_result: The types an attribute points at come back as plain class names, both for an attribute with one type and for the one with five.

name: test_unknown_class_raises_keyerror_naming_it
expected_result: Asking for a class that is not in the file is refused with an error naming it, so a typo is reported rather than answered with an empty result.

name: test_empty_file_is_refused
expected_result: An empty file is refused as 'empty or not a mapping' instead of being treated as a model with no classes.

name: test_class_without_modifier_is_named
expected_result: Deleting Modifier from one class is refused with a message naming that class.

name: test_unexpected_modifier_value_is_named
expected_result: A Modifier other than Concrete or Abstract is refused, and the message quotes the unexpected value, so a new USDM word cannot pass unnoticed.

name: test_attributes_not_a_mapping_is_named
expected_result: Turning a class's Attributes into a list is refused with a message naming the class, before any reading function could trip over it.

name: test_attribute_missing_a_key_is_named
expected_result: An attribute missing its Relationship Type field is refused, and the message names the class, the attribute and the missing field.

name: test_attribute_missing_several_keys_lists_them
expected_result: When more than one key is missing from an attribute, the message lists all of them, so one read of the error shows the whole problem.

name: test_type_that_is_not_a_reference_list_is_named
expected_result: A Type holding a plain word instead of a list of '$ref' entries is refused, naming Class.attribute and the field, rather than failing later inside the printer when it tries to walk the value.

name: test_empty_type_list_is_refused
expected_result: An attribute with an empty list of types is refused, and the message names the attribute, because an attribute with no type cannot be described.

name: test_inherited_from_without_ref_is_named
expected_result: An Inherited From entry that does not name its parent class is refused, and the message names the attribute and the field.

name: test_missing_file_raises_filenotfound
expected_result: A path that does not exist is refused as a missing file, exit 8 at the command line, which is a different failure from a file that fails its fingerprint.

name: test_unrecorded_file_is_refused_through_load
expected_result: A file no manifest entry records is refused when loaded, with a message saying exactly that rather than the remedy for a changed file.

name: test_fingerprint_mismatch_is_refused_through_load
expected_result: A file whose fingerprint differs from its record is refused when loaded, and the message shows both fingerprints and the ways to recover.

name: test_cli_no_mode_exits_2
expected_result: Running with no mode option is a usage error. The usage is printed and the run exits 2.

name: test_cli_missing_spec_exits_8
expected_result: When the pinned file is not downloaded, the command exits 8 and says to run acquire_sources.

name: test_cli_unrecorded_spec_exits_10
expected_result: When the file is present but no manifest entry records it, the command exits 10 and prints the cause.

name: test_cli_fingerprint_mismatch_exits_9
expected_result: When the file is present but its fingerprint differs from its manifest entry, the command exits 9 and prints both fingerprints and the way to proceed without the pin.

name: test_cli_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: When a manifest is not valid JSON, the command exits 3 and names the manifest as what cannot be read, rather than blaming the pinned file.

name: test_cli_not_inside_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the command exits 6 and prints the install command. It runs twice, with and without the option that skips the pinned-file record, because that option must not skip this refusal.

name: test_cli_wrong_shape_exits_4
expected_result: When the file loads but is not shaped like USDM, the command exits 4 and names the broken class.

name: test_cli_locked_file_exits_13
expected_result: When the pinned file is on disk but another program has it locked, the command exits 13 and says to close that program, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_cli_malformed_type_exits_4_not_traceback
expected_result: A file whose type values are not lists of references makes the attributes option exit 4 and name the attribute, rather than failing with a Python error while printing.

name: test_cli_allow_unpinned_reads_the_file
expected_result: With the allow-unpinned option, the manifest check is skipped and a file no manifest records is read in place, listing its classes and exiting 0.

name: test_cli_attributes_prints_type_cardinality_kind
expected_result: The attributes listing prints each attribute's type, cardinality and kind, marks inherited ones with their parent, and exits 0.

name: test_cli_unknown_class_exits_5
expected_result: The attributes listing for a class that does not exist exits 5 and points at the class listing, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_class_with_no_definition_is_listed_without_one
expected_result: Asking for the attributes of a class that has no Definition prints the class and its attributes, with no definition line, rather than failing.

name: test_cli_manifest_location_outside_inputs_exits_66
expected_result: When a manifest records a location that does not stay under inputs/, the command exits 66 and quotes the location, rather than reporting an unreadable manifest.

name: test_cli_a_file_that_is_not_yaml_exits_4
expected_result: When the model file is not valid YAML and the pinned-file record is skipped, the command exits 4 and says the file is not valid YAML, rather than stopping on a traceback.

name: test_every_listed_document_is_recorded_by_a_manifest
expected_result: Every file src/sdg/view/lookup_documents.yml lists is recorded by a manifest, as the list's own rules require, so read_pdf never meets an entry it cannot find.

name: test_every_row_becomes_a_document
expected_result: Each row in the lookup document list becomes one document, known by the key a person types.

name: test_the_manifest_is_carried_for_the_missing_file_message
expected_result: A document carries the manifest that records it, which the missing-file message tells a person to restore from.

name: test_boilerplate_patterns_are_compiled
expected_result: A boilerplate pattern is compiled, and it matches the repeated header and footer lines it was written for.

name: test_an_empty_boilerplate_list_strips_nothing
expected_result: A document with nothing repeated on its pages carries no patterns.

name: test_the_default_is_the_one_the_list_names
expected_result: The document used when none is named is the one the lookup document list names as its default.

name: test_docs_names_every_document
expected_result: With every listed document on disk, the docs option names each one.

name: test_docs_exits_0_when_every_document_is_present
expected_result: With every listed document on disk, the docs option exits 0.

name: test_a_missing_list_is_refused
expected_result: With no lookup document list on disk, loading is refused, and the message names the path and says to restore it from git.

name: test_a_list_that_is_not_yaml_is_refused
expected_result: A lookup document list that is not valid YAML is refused with a message saying so, rather than failing later on its shape.

name: test_a_list_with_no_documents_is_refused
expected_result: A lookup document list with no documents in it is refused, and the message says which part is missing.

name: test_a_row_missing_a_field_is_refused
expected_result: A row without its label is refused, and the message names the missing field.

name: test_a_row_that_is_not_a_set_of_fields_is_refused
expected_result: A row that is a single value rather than a set of fields is refused, and the message quotes the value.

name: test_a_boilerplate_that_is_not_a_list_is_refused
expected_result: Boilerplate patterns written as anything but a list are refused, and the message names the row. A single pattern or an empty-looking value is never read wrongly.

name: test_a_file_no_manifest_records_is_refused
expected_result: A row naming a file that no manifest records is refused, and the message names the file and says to correct the name or record the file.

name: test_a_default_that_is_not_listed_is_refused
expected_result: A default naming a key the lookup document list does not hold is refused, so the document option never has a default it cannot accept.

name: test_a_missing_list_exits_31
expected_result: When the lookup document list is missing, the command exits 31 and says where the file was expected and how to get it back.

name: test_a_file_no_manifest_records_exits_32
expected_result: When the lookup document list names a file no manifest records, the command exits 32, a different cause from a list that cannot be read.

name: test_not_inside_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the command exits 6 and prints the install command, because the manifests that record each document cannot be found from anywhere else.

name: test_an_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: When a manifest is not valid JSON, the command exits 3 and names that manifest as what cannot be read, rather than blaming the document list or a document.

name: test_docs_exits_8_when_a_document_is_not_downloaded
expected_result: When a listed document is recorded but not on disk, listing the documents exits 8 and says to run acquire_sources.

name: test_a_section_is_found_by_number
expected_result: Asking for a section by its number prints that section's text.

name: test_a_section_is_found_by_title
expected_result: Asking for part of a section's title prints that section.

name: test_the_section_map_lists_every_section
expected_result: The section map names every section the document's bookmarks hold.

name: test_a_page_range_is_printed
expected_result: A page range prints those pages, which is the mode a document without bookmarks is read by.

name: test_a_two_page_range_prints_both_pages_in_order
expected_result: A range of two pages prints both, first page first.

name: test_a_term_is_searched_for_across_pages
expected_result: A search names the page that contains the term and shows the matching line, rather than answering that no page contains it.

name: test_page_furniture_is_stripped
expected_result: A line matching the document's boilerplate pattern is left out of an extract, so a section reads as its own content.

name: test_raw_keeps_the_page_furniture
expected_result: With the raw option the boilerplate is kept, for a session that needs the page exactly as it is.

name: test_a_section_that_does_not_exist_exits_23
expected_result: Asking for a section the document does not hold exits 23, rather than printing nothing and reading as though the content were absent.

name: test_section_mode_on_a_document_without_bookmarks_exits_24
expected_result: Asking for a section of a document that carries no bookmarks exits 24 and names the modes that do work on it.

name: test_a_page_range_that_is_not_numbers_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range that is not a number, or two joined by a dash, exits 2 and shows the form a range takes.

name: test_a_page_range_with_a_trailing_dash_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range written with a dash and no second number exits 2, rather than being read as the one page before the dash.

name: test_a_page_range_starting_before_page_1_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range starting at 0 exits 2 and says so, rather than printing the last page under the label page 0.

name: test_a_page_range_past_the_document_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range running past the last page exits 2 and says how many pages the document has, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_page_range_ending_before_it_starts_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A page range whose last page comes before its first exits 2 and says so, rather than printing a heading with nothing under it.

name: test_a_document_not_downloaded_exits_8
expected_result: Reading a document that is recorded but not on disk exits 8 and names the manifest to restore it from.

name: test_the_previous_sections_text_is_left_out_at_the_start
expected_result: When a section begins part way down a page, the text of the section before it on that page is left out of the extract.

name: test_the_next_sections_text_is_left_out_when_both_share_one_page
expected_result: When a section and the next both sit on one page, reading the first gives its own text and leaves out the next section's, so the two return different text.

name: test_the_next_sections_text_is_left_out_at_the_end
expected_result: When the next section begins on a section's last page, the next section's text on that page is left out of the extract.

name: test_a_page_with_a_picture_gets_the_not_shown_note
expected_result: A page holding a picture gets a note saying one image is not shown, so the gap in the text is visible.

name: test_a_page_with_a_table_gets_the_not_shown_note
expected_result: A page holding a ruled table gets a note saying one table is not shown.

name: test_a_ligature_is_decomposed_for_searching
expected_result: The searchable form of text holding the fi ligature, a single character standing for the two letters f and i, spells the word with its plain letters, so a search for the word finds it.

name: test_an_exact_section_number_beats_a_title_match
expected_result: A section whose number is exactly what was typed is chosen over an earlier section whose title merely contains it.

name: test_a_trailing_period_on_a_section_number_is_tolerated
expected_result: A section number typed with a trailing period finds the same section.

name: test_a_search_hit_names_the_section_it_falls_in
expected_result: A search hit on a document with bookmarks names the section its page falls in.

name: test_a_section_whose_own_heading_is_missing_warns_that_it_may_open_mid_section
expected_result: When a section's own heading is not on the page its bookmark points at, the page is shown whole. A warning names the section and the page and says the extract may open mid-section.

name: test_a_next_sections_missing_heading_warns_that_it_may_run_past_the_section
expected_result: When the next section's heading is not on the page a section ends on, the page is shown whole. A warning names that section and the page and says the extract may run past its end.

name: test_the_warning_is_kept_out_of_the_extracted_text
expected_result: A warning goes to standard error and never into the extracted text, so it cannot be read as a line of the document.

name: test_an_extracted_page_carries_the_note_about_what_it_lost
expected_result: A page holding a picture carries its not-shown note inside its own block, so the gap sits beside the text it belongs to.

name: test_a_page_whose_tables_cannot_be_read_still_extracts
expected_result: When the table finder fails on a page, the page's text is still extracted and the note counts no tables. A table that cannot be counted must not stop a person reading the page.

name: test_a_search_that_matches_nothing_says_so_and_exits_0
expected_result: A search that matches no page says so and exits 0, because finding nothing is an answer rather than a failure.

name: test_a_search_hit_cuts_a_long_line_short
expected_result: A hit on a line longer than 110 characters shows the first 110 and an ellipsis, so one wide page line does not fill the search output.

name: test_a_section_ends_at_a_next_heading_that_carries_no_number
expected_result: When the next bookmark carries no number, the section ends at that bookmark's title on the shared page. The section's own text on that page is kept and the next section's text is left out.

name: test_a_missing_heading_that_carries_no_number_warns
expected_result: When the next bookmark carries no number and its title is not on the page a section ends on, the page is shown whole. A warning names that title and the page and says the extract may run past the section.

name: test_a_section_that_carries_no_number_is_printed_from_its_start_page
expected_result: A section whose bookmark carries no number is found by its title and printed from its start page to the end of the document, with its own text in the extract.

name: test_a_file_name_two_entries_record_exits_3
expected_result: A row naming a file name that two manifest entries record makes the command exit 3 rather than open either file. The message names the location of both, says the two pinned files share the name, and says the code asking for it has to choose one version.

name: test_a_manifest_location_outside_inputs_exits_66
expected_result: When a manifest records a location that does not stay under inputs/, the command exits 66 and quotes the location, rather than reporting an unreadable manifest.

name: test_a_boilerplate_pattern_that_is_not_a_regular_expression_exits_31
expected_result: A boilerplate pattern that is not a valid regular expression makes the command exit 31, and the message names the document and quotes the pattern, rather than stopping on a traceback.

name: test_the_path_comes_from_the_manifest
expected_result: A document's path is taken from the manifest entry that records the file name the lookup document list gives, so the list never says where a file lives.

name: test_a_section_that_carries_no_number_starts_at_its_title
expected_result: When a section whose bookmark carries no number begins part way down a page, the extract starts at that bookmark's title, so the text of the section before it on that page is left out.

name: test_a_missing_own_heading_that_carries_no_number_warns
expected_result: When a section's bookmark carries no number and its title is not on the page the section starts on, the page is shown whole. A warning names that title and the page and says the extract may open mid-section.

name: test_an_appendix_heading_written_with_a_colon_is_found
expected_result: An appendix heading written as the label followed by a colon, such as "Appendix B: Second List", is found on its page. Reading that appendix leaves out the text of the appendix before it on the same page, and no warning is printed.

name: test_a_colon_after_a_section_number_is_not_taken_for_its_heading
expected_result: A line that opens with a section number followed by a colon, such as "2: the second point" in a numbered list, is not taken for the heading of section 2. Only an appendix label may be followed by a colon.

name: test_a_name_fragment_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A fragment of a filename finds the one workbook it matches, so a nested path never has to be typed. The listing printed is that workbook's own, with its name and its notes sheet.

name: test_listing_names_every_sheet
expected_result: Naming a workbook without a sheet lists every sheet it holds.

name: test_listing_survives_a_sheet_without_a_dimension_record
expected_result: A workbook whose sheet file carries no dimension record, which some writers leave out, is still listed with its sheet named and the counts left blank, rather than ending in a traceback.

name: test_a_sheet_prints_as_a_table
expected_result: A named sheet prints as a table holding the cells it was written with.

name: test_a_sheet_name_matches_whatever_the_case
expected_result: A sheet name is matched whatever its case, so mainTimeline answers to maintimeline. The sheet printed is the one named, not the first sheet.

name: test_records_format_prints_one_field_per_line
expected_result: In records format each field is on its own line, which is what makes a sheet too wide for a table readable.

name: test_an_empty_cell_prints_as_nothing
expected_result: An empty cell prints as blank rather than as the word None, which would fill a sparse schedule grid with noise.

name: test_a_newline_inside_a_cell_does_not_break_the_row
expected_result: A cell holding a newline is printed on one line, so the row stays aligned.

name: test_find_reports_the_hits_in_one_workbook
expected_result: Searching one workbook reports each cell that contains the term by its sheet and row, rather than answering that no cell contains it.

name: test_find_with_no_hits_says_so_and_exits_0
expected_result: A search that matches nothing says so and exits 0, because finding nothing is an answer rather than a failure.

name: test_all_searches_every_workbook
expected_result: With the all option the search covers every workbook under the inputs folder, not just one.

name: test_an_excel_lock_file_is_not_a_workbook
expected_result: A ~$ lock file that Excel leaves beside an open workbook is left out of discovery, because opening one raises rather than reading.

name: test_a_sheet_that_does_not_exist_exits_25
expected_result: Naming a sheet the workbook does not hold exits 25 and says to run without the sheet option to list them.

name: test_a_workbook_that_matches_nothing_exits_26
expected_result: A name matching no workbook exits 26 and repeats the name that was looked for.

name: test_an_ambiguous_name_exits_26_listing_the_matches
expected_result: A fragment matching more than one workbook exits 26 and lists what it matched, so the next attempt can be exact.

name: test_all_without_find_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: Asking for the all option without the find option exits 2, the argument parser's own code, because it is a mistake in the command line.

name: test_no_workbook_named_is_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: Running with no workbook named exits 2 and lists the workbooks a person can name.

name: test_a_full_path_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A workbook named by its full path is opened, and the listing printed is that workbook's own.

name: test_a_repo_relative_path_finds_the_workbook
expected_result: A workbook named by its path from the repo root is opened, whichever folder the command was started from, and the listing printed is that workbook's own.

name: test_a_filename_is_matched_whatever_its_case
expected_result: A filename typed in the wrong case finds the workbook, and the listing printed is that workbook's own.

name: test_a_long_cell_is_cut_short_with_an_ellipsis_in_a_table
expected_result: In table format a cell longer than the width limit is cut short and ends with an ellipsis, so one long note cannot push the other columns off the screen.

name: test_an_empty_field_is_skipped_in_records_format
expected_result: In records format a row's empty field is left out rather than printed as a header with nothing after it, which keeps a sparse grid readable.

name: test_a_search_reports_one_hit_per_row
expected_result: A row in which the term appears in two cells is reported once, since one line is enough to find the row.

name: test_a_search_hit_cuts_a_long_cell_short
expected_result: A hit in a cell longer than 120 characters shows the first 120 characters and an ellipsis, so one wide cell does not dominate the search output.

name: test_header_row_makes_the_named_row_the_column_names
expected_result: With the header-row option, the named row supplies the column names and the lines above it are left out, so a sheet carrying a title prints as a table of its real data.

name: test_header_row_counts_the_sheets_own_rows_including_blank_ones
expected_result: Rows are numbered the way the sheet numbers them, so a blank row above the column names still takes a number. That is the number a spreadsheet program shows.

name: test_the_heading_says_which_row_the_reading_started_at
expected_result: The heading line names the row the reading started at, so a printed table carries the number that produced it and can be run again.

name: test_without_the_option_the_first_row_is_the_column_names
expected_result: Without the header-row option, reading starts at the first row and the heading says nothing about a starting row, so an ordinary sheet is unaffected.

name: test_a_header_row_past_the_end_of_the_sheet_is_refused
expected_result: A row number beyond the sheet's last row is refused with its own exit code, and the message names the sheet and the number.

name: test_a_header_row_below_one_is_refused_as_a_usage_mistake
expected_result: A row number below 1 names no row, so the argument parser refuses it and the message says the number is the sheet's own and starts at 1.

name: test_an_empty_sheet_says_so
expected_result: A sheet with no rows prints that the sheet is empty, rather than a header with nothing under it or an error. It runs once for each output format.

name: test_a_row_with_every_cell_blank_is_left_out
expected_result: A row whose every cell is blank is left out of the output, so it does not show as an empty record.

name: test_all_names_only_the_workbooks_with_hits
expected_result: With the all option, a workbook that holds no match is not named, so the listing shows only where the term was found.

name: test_records_format_and_find_give_a_row_the_same_number
expected_result: In records format each row is headed by the number the sheet gives it, the same number the search option reports for it, so a row cited from either can be found in Excel.

name: test_a_real_text_stream_is_switched_to_utf8
expected_result: When standard output is a normal text stream, it is switched to UTF-8 for the rest of the run.

name: test_a_captured_stream_is_left_alone_without_error
expected_result: When standard output is not a normal text stream, as when another program has captured it, it is left as it was and no error is raised.

name: test_real_index_is_current
expected_result: docs/commands.md matches the headers of the real commands that pyproject.toml installs, which is the run the pre-commit hook makes.

name: test_writes_the_entry_from_the_header
expected_result: docs/commands.md holds each command under a heading of its name, with the first paragraph of its Description joined to one line, the file its header block is in, and its Usage block with the relative indentation kept.

name: test_the_second_paragraph_is_left_out
expected_result: Only the first paragraph of a Description reaches docs/commands.md, and the rest stays in the header.

name: test_the_index_opens_with_the_title_and_the_notice
expected_result: docs/commands.md opens with its title and the notice saying it is generated, so nobody edits it by hand.

name: test_the_index_ends_with_one_newline
expected_result: docs/commands.md ends with exactly one new line, so a regenerated file compares equal to itself and the check option does not fail on spacing.

name: test_the_index_is_written_with_lf_line_endings
expected_result: docs/commands.md ends each line the same way whatever machine regenerates it, so the file does not change between one run and the next.

name: test_writing_reports_the_file_and_the_count
expected_result: A run that writes docs/commands.md exits 0 and says which file it wrote and how many commands it holds.

name: test_scripts_are_listed_in_name_order
expected_result: Two commands of one package appear in alphabetical order whatever order pyproject.toml lists them in, so docs/commands.md is stable between runs.

name: test_check_passes_when_index_is_current
expected_result: With the check option, the run exits 0 and writes nothing when docs/commands.md on disk equals what would be generated.

name: test_check_fails_when_index_is_missing
expected_result: With the check option and no page on disk, the run exits 15, names the command to run, and writes nothing.

name: test_check_fails_when_index_is_stale
expected_result: With the check option and a page that no longer matches the headers, the run exits 15, names the command to run, and leaves the stale page as it was.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing is printed. The exit code is the whole report.

name: test_missing_field_exits_17_and_writes_nothing
expected_result: A header missing required fields exits 17, naming the file and every missing field, and docs/commands.md is not written.

name: test_no_docstring_exits_17
expected_result: A command's file with no docstring at the top has no header block at all, and the run exits 17 and says so.

name: test_unparseable_script_exits_19_and_outranks_17
expected_result: A command's file that is not valid Python exits 19, and 19 outranks 17 when another command's header is also incomplete. Both problems are still named.

name: test_no_scripts_exits_20
expected_result: A pyproject.toml that installs no command exits 20 and says so.

name: test_a_one_line_usage_is_indexed_as_written
expected_result: A Usage field written on one line is indexed as that one line.

name: test_a_description_opening_with_a_blank_line_is_indexed
expected_result: A Description whose text starts on the line after its label, below a blank line, is still indexed by its first paragraph.

name: test_a_script_not_saved_as_utf8_exits_19
expected_result: A command's file that is not saved as UTF-8 text exits 19, and the line names the file and says it is not saved as UTF-8 text.

name: test_a_one_paragraph_description_is_indexed_whole
expected_result: A Description of one paragraph, with no second paragraph after it, is indexed whole, joined into one line.

name: test_commands_are_grouped_by_package_in_a_fixed_order
expected_result: The commands of each package appear under that package's heading, and the headings run pipeline commands, then repo tools, then validation commands, whatever the commands' names.

name: test_a_package_with_no_command_gets_no_heading
expected_result: A package that installs no command has no heading on docs/commands.md.

name: test_a_file_no_command_runs_is_left_out
expected_result: A file in a package that pyproject.toml installs as no command, such as a pytest plugin, does not appear on docs/commands.md, even when it carries a complete header block.

name: test_a_missing_pyproject_exits_13
expected_result: With no pyproject.toml in the repo, the run exits 13, the message says the file cannot be read, and docs/commands.md is not written.

name: test_a_pyproject_that_cannot_be_parsed_exits_64
expected_result: A pyproject.toml whose text is not a valid settings file exits 64, and the message says it cannot be parsed.

name: test_a_scripts_table_of_the_wrong_shape_exits_64
expected_result: A [project.scripts] table that maps a command to something other than a module and function exits 64, and the message says how an entry is written.

name: test_a_command_from_a_package_with_no_heading_exits_64
expected_result: A command from a package that has no heading on the page exits 64, the message names the command and says to add the package to COMMAND_GROUPS, and docs/commands.md is not written.

name: test_a_command_whose_file_is_missing_exits_64
expected_result: A command whose file does not exist exits 64, the message names the command and the missing file and says to correct the entry or restore the file, and docs/commands.md is not written.

name: test_a_wrong_command_outranks_a_broken_header
expected_result: A command whose file is missing exits 64 when another command's file is also not valid Python, because the list of commands decides which headers are read. Both problems are still named.

name: test_working_key_exits_0
expected_result: A key the API answers gives an exit code of 0.

name: test_working_key_reports_the_reply
expected_result: The report names the model that answered and repeats what it replied.

name: test_the_key_is_never_printed
expected_result: The key itself is never printed, so it cannot end up in a terminal log.

name: test_quoted_key_is_read
expected_result: A key written with quotes around it, as a person might paste it, is read without them.

name: test_quiet_missing_key_exits_28_and_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, a missing key still exits 28, and nothing at all is printed.

name: test_missing_env_file_is_refused
expected_result: With no .env file at all, the run exits 27 and the message says to create it from the example.

name: test_empty_key_is_refused
expected_result: With a .env whose key line is empty, the run exits 28 and the message says to paste the key into that file.

name: test_rejected_key_is_reported_as_rejected
expected_result: When the API does not recognise the key, the run exits 29 and the message says the key was rejected and where to get a new one.

name: test_key_without_access_is_reported_as_an_account_problem
expected_result: When the API knows the key but will not let it use the model, the run exits 43. The message says the key is right and points at the account, rather than saying to paste the key again.

name: test_unreachable_api_is_reported_as_unreachable
expected_result: When the API cannot be reached at all, the run exits 30 and the message says to confirm the network connection rather than the key.

name: test_an_error_the_api_answered_with_is_reported_with_its_message
expected_result: When the API answers with an error that is neither a rejected key nor a failed connection, such as a retired model name, the run exits 41 and prints the API's own message.

name: test_outside_the_repo_is_refused
expected_result: When the sdg package is installed from outside the repo, the run exits 6 before it looks for a .env file.

name: test_the_request_carries_the_key_the_pinned_model_and_the_prompt
expected_result: The call uses the key it was given and sends the pinned model, the prompt and the tool's reply limit. So the answer proves that key against that model, not against whatever is newest.

name: test_the_reply_is_the_text_with_surrounding_spaces_removed
expected_result: The reply handed back is the text of the first text block, with surrounding spaces and newlines removed, so the word the tool prints is the word the model sent and nothing around it.

name: test_a_block_that_is_not_text_is_passed_over
expected_result: A reply whose first block is not text gives back the first text block after it, because a reply may carry blocks of other kinds before the words.

name: test_a_reply_with_no_text_gives_an_empty_answer
expected_result: A reply with no text in it gives back an empty string instead of stopping with a Python error.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing_when_the_key_works
expected_result: With the quiet option, a key the API answers exits 0 and nothing at all is printed.

name: test_every_refusal_is_silent_under_quiet
expected_result: With the quiet option, a refusal prints nothing and still exits with its own code. It runs once for each refusal the tool can give after its settings are read.

name: test_real_documents_match_real_corpus
expected_result: Against the pinned files and the committed documents, every stated figure is measured again and matches, and the run exits 0. It is skipped as blocked when a pinned file it reads has changed.

name: test_matching_figure_exits_0
expected_result: A document stating the measured number passes with exit 0, and the verbose option shows a line naming the fact, the file and the value.

name: test_drifted_figure_exits_14
expected_result: A document stating a different number is reported as drifted, with the stated and measured values, and the run exits 14.

name: test_every_occurrence_is_checked
expected_result: When the same figure appears twice and one copy is out of date, that copy is reported. A correct first copy does not hide it.

name: test_number_written_as_a_word_is_read
expected_result: A small count written as a word ("three") matches the measured 3, so prose is not forced to use digits.

name: test_a_date_is_compared_as_text
expected_result: A measurement that gives a date passes when the document states the same date, and the run exits 0. A date is compared as text, like a count.

name: test_a_drifted_date_exits_14
expected_result: A document naming a different date from the measured one is reported as drifted with both dates, and the run exits 14. That is how a folder named for the wrong date is caught.

name: test_each_measurement_failure_has_its_own_exit_code
expected_result: A measurement that fails is reported under a label naming the cause, with the error's own message. The run exits with that cause's number from docs/exit_codes.csv. It runs once for each cause.

name: test_a_figure_stated_nowhere_exits_65
expected_result: A recorded figure that no document states makes the run exit 65, and the report names the fact, its measured value and the fix.

name: test_a_drifted_figure_outranks_one_stated_nowhere
expected_result: When one figure has drifted and another is stated in no document, the run exits 14, and the report still names both.

name: test_a_tracked_document_in_any_folder_is_read
expected_result: A figure stated in a tracked Markdown file inside a nested folder is compared, so the run exits 0 rather than reporting the figure as stated nowhere.

name: test_decisions_md_is_not_read
expected_result: A figure in DECISIONS.md is not compared, because that file records what was true on a past date, so a different figure there leaves the run at exit 0.

name: test_an_untracked_document_is_not_read
expected_result: A Markdown file git does not track is not compared, so a different figure in it leaves the run at exit 0.

name: test_git_that_cannot_be_run_exits_22
expected_result: When git cannot be run, the run exits 22 before any measurement, and the report says git could not be run and to install it.

name: test_the_concepts_date_is_read_from_the_file_its_manifest_names
expected_result: The newest package date is read from the file whose manifest entry carries the concepts export's name, wherever that entry says the file lives, so check_facts writes no location of its own.

name: test_an_example_folder_with_no_usdm_export_is_passed_over
expected_result: A worked-example folder that holds no USDM export is passed over, and the studies in the other folders are still counted.

name: test_no_entry_named_for_the_concepts_export_is_refused
expected_result: When no manifest entry carries the concepts export's name, as after the record was renamed, the date is not measured, and the error names the file name that was looked for.

name: test_an_empty_date_cell_is_passed_over
expected_result: A package row whose date cell is empty is passed over, and the newest date is taken from the rows that carry one.

name: test_git_that_does_not_answer_exits_22
expected_result: When git runs but refuses to list the tracked files, as it does outside a repository, the run exits 22 before any measurement, and the report says git did not answer and to run check_facts from inside the repo's clone.

name: test_a_tracked_document_deleted_from_the_folder_is_passed_over
expected_result: A tracked Markdown file that has been deleted from the working folder, but whose deletion is not yet committed, states nothing, so the run compares the documents still there and exits 0.

name: test_matching_database_exits_0
expected_result: A database that answers with the pinned version gives an exit code of 0.

name: test_matching_database_reports_the_version
expected_result: The report names the address it reached and the version that answered.

name: test_the_password_is_never_printed
expected_result: The password itself is never printed, so it cannot end up in a terminal log.

name: test_quoted_settings_are_read
expected_result: Settings written with quotes around them, as a person might paste them, are read without them.

name: test_the_pin_is_read_from_the_image_tag
expected_result: The version and edition are read from the image tag in docker-compose.yml.

name: test_quiet_missing_settings_exit_37_and_print_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, missing settings still exit 37, and nothing at all is printed.

name: test_missing_env_file_is_refused
expected_result: With no .env file at all, the run exits 27 and the message says to create it from the example.

name: test_missing_settings_are_refused_by_name
expected_result: With a .env holding only one of the Neo4j lines, the run exits 37 and the message names both missing settings.

name: test_missing_compose_file_is_refused
expected_result: With no docker-compose.yml, the run exits 13 and the message says to restore it from git.

name: test_compose_file_without_an_image_is_refused
expected_result: With a docker-compose.yml that names no image for the neo4j service, the run exits 64 and the message names the missing line.

name: test_unpinned_image_tag_is_refused
expected_result: With an image written without a version, the run exits 64 and the message shows the form the tag has to take.

name: test_unreachable_database_is_reported_as_unreachable
expected_result: When nothing answers at the address, the run exits 38 and the message says to start the container with docker compose.

name: test_a_driver_error_is_reported_as_unreachable
expected_result: When the database driver fails with its general error, the run still exits 38 and says to start the container, because that is what the driver gives when a connection drops part way.

name: test_a_malformed_address_is_reported_as_the_address
expected_result: When the driver refuses the database address before trying to connect, the run exits 44 and the message names the address line in .env, rather than saying the database is off.

name: test_rejected_login_is_reported_as_rejected
expected_result: When the database refuses the user or password, the run exits 39 and the message says to match .env to the compose file.

name: test_other_version_is_reported_with_both_versions
expected_result: When the database answers with a version other than the pin, the run exits 40 and the message names both the running and the pinned version.

name: test_other_edition_is_reported_as_another_version
expected_result: When the database is the pinned version number but another edition, the run exits 40, because the pin names the edition too.

name: test_outside_the_repo_is_refused
expected_result: When the sdg package is installed from outside the repo, the run exits 6 before it looks for a .env file.

name: test_the_driver_is_built_from_the_settings_and_the_timeout
expected_result: The driver is built with the address, user and password read from .env, and with the connection timeout the tool sets, so a database that is off gives up rather than hanging.

name: test_connectivity_is_verified_before_the_query_is_sent
expected_result: Connectivity is verified before the query is sent, so nothing answering fails at once instead of being retried for seconds with a warning on each attempt.

name: test_the_connection_is_closed_even_when_the_query_fails
expected_result: A query that fails still leaves the connection closed, and its error reaches the caller unchanged, so the tool can give the right exit code.

name: test_the_version_is_taken_from_the_kernel_row
expected_result: The version and edition come from the row naming the database kernel, not from another component's row, because the query answers with one row per component and the others carry versions of their own.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing_when_the_database_matches
expected_result: With the quiet option, a database that answers with the pinned version exits 0 and nothing at all is printed.

name: test_every_refusal_is_silent_under_quiet
expected_result: With the quiet option, a refusal prints nothing and still exits with its own code. It runs once for each refusal the tool can give other than missing settings.

name: test_every_python_file_passes_the_style_and_type_tools
expected_result: Every Python file in the real repo passes the formatter in check mode, the style rules and the type checker, which is the run the pre-commit hook makes.

name: test_each_tool_covers_the_folders_the_rule_names
expected_result: Each tool that holds the Python files to .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md covers the folders in the rule's paths list, and no others, so a file the rule covers is never missed and no other file is judged by it. It runs once for each tool setting: ruff's include and src settings, mypy's files, the folders verify_headers reads, and coverage's source, which leaves out validation/.

name: test_helper_functions_in_check_files_carry_type_hints
expected_result: Every function in a check file or in validation/conftest.py that is neither a check nor a pytest fixture carries a type hint on each argument and on its return, as .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md requires. That includes a function nested inside another and the method of a class.

name: test_all_passing_exits_0
expected_result: When every tool passes, the run exits 0.

name: test_each_tool_gets_a_verdict_line
expected_result: Every tool gets its own line saying it passed.

name: test_the_tools_run_in_the_set_order
expected_result: The three tools run in the order ruff format, ruff check, mypy, so the formatter's report comes before the linter's and the type checker's.

name: test_the_tools_run_from_the_repo_root
expected_result: Every tool runs from the repo root, so pyproject.toml is found whichever folder the tool was started from.

name: test_a_tool_off_the_path_is_run_through_conda
expected_result: When ruff and mypy are not on the path but conda is, each runs through conda in the sdg environment instead.

name: test_quiet_keeps_the_verdicts_and_drops_the_progress_lines
expected_result: With the quiet option, the line announcing each tool is left out but the verdict lines stay.

name: test_a_failing_tool_exits_21_and_is_named
expected_result: When one tool reports a problem, the run exits 21, and that tool's line says FAILED while the others say passed.

name: test_every_tool_still_runs_after_one_fails
expected_result: When the first tool fails, the other two still run, so one run shows everything that needs fixing.

name: test_no_tool_and_no_conda_exits_22
expected_result: When neither the tool nor conda is on the path, the run exits 22, names the tool, gives the fix, and runs nothing.

name: test_a_tool_that_does_not_start_exits_22_and_is_named
expected_result: When a tool does not answer when asked for its version, the run exits 22, names that tool and says to confirm or recreate the sdg environment. Each run stages one way a tool can fail to start: through conda, on the path with an error, or not launchable at all.

name: test_no_tool_runs_when_one_does_not_start
expected_result: When mypy, the last tool, does not start, neither ruff run is made, so a report is never half printed.

name: test_the_formatter_runs_in_check_mode
expected_result: The formatter runs in check mode, so a file that is not formatted is reported and never rewritten.

name: test_the_real_map_and_manifests_agree
expected_result: Nothing is missing from either side of the repo's sources map, docs/sources_index.md. Every file a manifest records has a heading that covers it, and every location the map names holds a recorded file.

name: test_a_map_naming_every_file_exits_0
expected_result: A map with a heading for every recorded file, and a location the files live in, exits 0.

name: test_a_map_naming_every_file_prints_nothing
expected_result: When the map and the manifests agree, nothing is printed.

name: test_a_placeholder_heading_covers_a_group
expected_result: A heading written with a placeholder stands for every file of that shape, which is how one section covers a file per study.

name: test_a_starred_heading_covers_a_subfolder
expected_result: A heading written with a star and a subfolder covers the files in it, which is how one section covers a folder of diagrams.

name: test_one_heading_may_name_two_files
expected_result: A heading naming two files joined by the word and covers both, as the two API files are written.

name: test_a_file_with_no_heading_exits_35
expected_result: A recorded file that no heading covers exits 35, and the line names the file, which is the failure this tool was written for.

name: test_a_placeholder_heading_does_not_reach_outside_its_group
expected_result: A placeholder heading in one group does not cover a file of the same shape in another group, so the run exits 35 and names that file.

name: test_a_location_nothing_lives_in_exits_36
expected_result: A location line naming a folder no manifest records a file in exits 36, and the line names the folder.

name: test_a_missing_file_outranks_an_empty_location
expected_result: When a file has no heading and a location holds nothing, the run exits 35, because a file nobody can find is the worse problem.

name: test_a_missing_map_exits_13
expected_result: With no map on disk, the run exits 13 and says the map cannot be read, rather than reporting every recorded file as unmapped.

name: test_not_inside_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the run exits 6 with the install command, instead of reporting a file with no heading.

name: test_an_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: When a manifest is not valid JSON, the run exits 3 and names that manifest as what cannot be read, instead of comparing a map against nothing.

name: test_quiet_file_with_no_heading_exits_35_and_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, a recorded file that has no heading in the map still exits 35, and nothing is printed.

name: test_every_refusal_is_silent_under_quiet
expected_result: With the quiet option, a refusal prints nothing and still exits with its own code. It runs once each for an install outside the repo, an unreadable manifest, a manifest location that does not stay under inputs/, and an unreadable map.

name: test_a_heading_with_no_location_covers_no_file
expected_result: A document heading with no location line above it covers no recorded file, so the file it names is reported as having no heading and the run exits 35.

name: test_a_heading_in_another_case_covers_no_file
expected_result: A document heading whose file name differs from the recorded file only in upper and lower case does not cover it, so the run exits 35 and names the file.

name: test_a_location_in_another_case_holds_no_file
expected_result: A location line whose folder differs from a recorded folder only in upper and lower case holds no recorded file, so the run exits 36 and names the location.

name: test_a_manifest_location_outside_inputs_exits_66
expected_result: When a manifest records a location that does not stay under inputs/, the run exits 66 and quotes the location, instead of comparing a map against it.

name: test_recorded_files_only_exits_0
expected_result: When every file under inputs/ is recorded, the run exits 0.

name: test_recorded_files_only_prints_nothing
expected_result: When every file under inputs/ is recorded, nothing is printed.

name: test_quiet_unrecorded_file_exits_10_and_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, an unrecorded file still makes the run exit 10, and nothing at all is printed.

name: test_own_files_are_not_reported
expected_result: A README.md and a .gitkeep under inputs/ are the project's own files and are not reported as unrecorded.

name: test_lock_file_is_not_reported
expected_result: An Excel ~$ lock file beside a workbook under inputs/ is not data and is not reported as unrecorded.

name: test_missing_inputs_folder_is_clean
expected_result: A repo with no inputs/ folder at all has nothing unrecorded and exits 0, as on a fresh clone before anything is downloaded.

name: test_unrecorded_file_exits_10_listed_by_path
expected_result: A file under inputs/ that no manifest records makes the run exit 10. The file is printed by its repo-relative path, and the summary counts the unrecorded files and says they cannot be restored from a clone.

name: test_part_file_is_reported
expected_result: An unfinished .part download under inputs/ is reported as unrecorded, since acquire_sources did not get to finish it.

name: test_unreadable_manifest_exits_3
expected_result: A manifest that is not valid JSON makes the run exit 3, and the message names the file and says it cannot be read.

name: test_no_manifests_exits_3
expected_result: An empty manifests folder makes the run exit 3, and the message says no manifests were found and how to restore them.

name: test_not_inside_the_repo_exits_6
expected_result: When the sdg package is not running from inside its repo, the run exits 6 with the install command, instead of reporting that no manifests were found.

name: test_every_refusal_is_silent_under_quiet
expected_result: With the quiet option, a refusal prints nothing and still exits with its own code. It runs once each for an install outside the repo, a manifest that cannot be read, and a manifest location that does not stay under inputs/.

name: test_a_manifest_location_outside_inputs_exits_66
expected_result: When a manifest records a location that does not stay under inputs/, the run exits 66 and quotes the location, instead of listing files against it.

name: test_real_headers_follow_the_rule
expected_result: Every Python file in the real code folders has a header block with the eight fields in order and a valid Date, as .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md requires.

name: test_real_exit_codes_agree_with_the_table_and_main
expected_result: In every Python file in the real code folders, each exit code the header lists opens with the wording docs/exit_codes.csv gives it, and each code the tool returns is listed.

name: test_every_code_folder_is_checked
expected_result: The header tool covers the three folders .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md names, so a file added under any of them is held to the header rule. The check holds its own copy of the three.

name: test_complete_header_exits_0
expected_result: A file whose header holds the eight fields in order makes the run exit 0.

name: test_complete_header_prints_nothing
expected_result: When every header is complete, nothing is printed.

name: test_init_file_is_skipped
expected_result: A package marker file with a one-paragraph docstring and no header block is not a problem, since it names its folder rather than describing a script.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing is printed even when a header is incomplete. The exit code is the whole report.

name: test_missing_fields_exit_17
expected_result: A header lacking fields makes the run exit 17, and the problem line names the file and every missing field.

name: test_fields_out_of_order_exit_17
expected_result: A header with its fields in the wrong order makes the run exit 17, and the problem line says so and shows the order found.

name: test_bad_date_exits_17
expected_result: A Date that is not a plain calendar date makes the run exit 17, and the problem line quotes the value found.

name: test_no_docstring_exits_17
expected_result: A file with no docstring at the top has no header block at all, and the run exits 17 with a problem line saying so.

name: test_unparseable_file_exits_19
expected_result: A file that is not valid Python makes the run exit 19, and the problem line says it cannot be parsed.

name: test_unparseable_outranks_incomplete
expected_result: When one file cannot be parsed and another has an incomplete header, the run exits 19, and both problems are still named.

name: test_wording_from_the_table_passes
expected_result: An entry written with the wording in docs/exit_codes.csv for its number passes.

name: test_a_bracketed_aside_is_allowed
expected_result: An entry may add a bracketed aside after the wording in docs/exit_codes.csv, saying what the cause means in that file.

name: test_a_wrapped_entry_is_read_as_one
expected_result: An entry too long for one line is joined before it is compared, so wrapping it does not make it disagree.

name: test_a_lone_wrapped_entry_keeps_its_second_line
expected_result: An entry that runs onto a second line and ends the field keeps its second line. So a header holding one long entry is not refused as disagreeing with docs/exit_codes.csv.

name: test_the_closing_prose_is_not_read_as_an_entry
expected_result: The sentence a field ends with is not mistaken for an entry, so it is never compared with docs/exit_codes.csv.

name: test_a_code_the_table_lacks_exits_33
expected_result: An entry for a number docs/exit_codes.csv does not hold makes the run exit 33, and the problem line names the file and the number.

name: test_different_wording_exits_33
expected_result: An entry giving a number a second meaning makes the run exit 33, and the problem line prints what the header says beside what docs/exit_codes.csv says.

name: test_an_incomplete_header_outranks_a_wrong_code
