expected_result: When one file has an incomplete header and another has a wrong code, the run exits 17, because a header that cannot be read is the worse problem.

name: test_an_unreadable_table_exits_13
expected_result: With docs/exit_codes.csv missing, the run exits 13 and says the file cannot be read, rather than reporting every file as disagreeing with nothing.

name: test_a_table_with_a_code_that_is_not_a_number_exits_64
expected_result: A row of docs/exit_codes.csv holding a code that is not a number makes the run exit 64, and the message says the file holds the wrong content and to correct the row, rather than ending in a Python error.

name: test_a_listed_return_passes
expected_result: An exit code that the tool can return and that its header lists passes.

name: test_a_return_of_a_call_is_passed_over
expected_result: A return of something other than a plain number is passed over rather than guessed at, so a computed exit code is never reported as unlisted.

name: test_a_listed_code_that_is_never_returned_is_not_a_problem
expected_result: A header may list a code the tool never returns as a plain number, because only codes a header forgot are looked for.

name: test_a_nested_helpers_return_is_not_read_as_mains
expected_result: A number returned by a helper inside the tool's main function belongs to the helper, so a header that does not list it is not refused.

name: test_an_unlisted_return_exits_34
expected_result: A code the tool returns that the header does not list makes the run exit 34, and the problem line names the file and the number.

name: test_both_sides_of_a_one_line_choice_are_read
expected_result: A return written as a one-line choice is read on both sides, so the branch that is not listed is still caught whichever side it sits on.

name: test_an_incomplete_header_outranks_a_forgotten_code
expected_result: When one file has no header and another forgets a code it returns, the run exits 17, because a header that cannot be read is the worse problem. Both problems are named.

name: test_a_forgotten_code_outranks_a_reworded_one
expected_result: When one file forgets a code and another rewords one, the run exits 34, because a missing code is the worse problem.

name: test_every_table_refusal_is_silent_under_quiet
expected_result: With the quiet option, a refusal of docs/exit_codes.csv prints nothing and still exits with its own code. It runs once for a missing table, which exits 13, and once for a table holding a code above 125, which exits 64.

name: test_a_header_with_no_exit_codes_field_is_refused
expected_result: A header with no Exit codes field makes the run exit 17, and the problem line names the field as missing.

name: test_a_main_with_no_numbered_code_exits_17
expected_result: A file with a main() whose Exit codes field is written only as a sentence makes the run exit 17, and the problem line names the file and says to list each code the file returns.

name: test_a_file_with_no_main_may_describe_its_codes_in_a_sentence
expected_result: A file with no main(), such as a check file, may write its Exit codes field as a sentence, and the run exits 0.

name: test_a_header_code_above_125_exits_33
expected_result: An entry for a number above 125 makes the run exit 33, and the problem line names the number and says 125 is the highest an exit code can take.

name: test_a_table_code_above_125_exits_64
expected_result: A row of docs/exit_codes.csv holding a number above 125 makes the run exit 64, and the message names the number and says to correct the row.

name: test_wording_that_reads_like_another_problem_still_exits_33
expected_result: An entry that gives a number a second meaning exits 33 even when its wording holds the words another kind of problem prints, because each problem carries its own exit code and the wording of a message never chooses it.

name: test_a_file_not_saved_as_utf8_exits_19
expected_result: A file that is not saved as UTF-8 text makes the run exit 19, and the problem line names the file and says it is not saved as UTF-8 text.

name: test_the_run_is_held_to_the_aspect_it_is_given
expected_result: Given the integrity aspect, the shared code writes a report named for integrity, in a folder named integrity, whose rows are the integrity checks alone.

name: test_real_inventory_is_current
expected_result: validation/validation_inventory.csv matches the checks in the real check files, which is the run the pre-commit hook makes.

name: test_row_holds_the_check_as_written
expected_result: A row carries the check's name, id, category, objective, case and the first paragraph of its docstring as one line, with the second paragraph left out.

name: test_row_names_the_check_file_and_the_target
expected_result: A check file under validation/sdgtools/ targets the script of the same name in src/sdgtools/, and both paths are written as a folder and a file name.

name: test_a_hook_check_targets_the_hook
expected_result: A check file under validation/claude_hooks/ targets the hook of the same name in .claude/hooks/.

name: test_a_check_that_staged_nothing_has_an_empty_case
expected_result: A check carrying no positive or negative marker gets a row with its objective and an empty staged case, whatever that objective is.

name: test_new_check_starts_active_at_version_1
expected_result: A check with no row yet starts as active at version 1, with no replacing checks and no reason recorded.

name: test_hand_kept_columns_are_carried_over_by_id
expected_result: When the inventory already has a row for a check's id, the four columns a person keeps by hand are kept as they were, whatever else changed.

name: test_groups_follow_the_pipeline_order
expected_result: Rows are grouped in the pipeline's order, sources first and the checks for validation's own files, such as validation/conftest.py, last, whatever order the files are found in.

name: test_a_check_file_in_a_package_subfolder_targets_that_subfolder_under_src
expected_result: A check file at validation/<package>/<folder>/ targets the file of the same name at src/<package>/<folder>/, so the pipeline's checks mirror src/sdg/ one level down.

name: test_a_top_level_check_file_targets_the_validation_file_of_the_same_name
expected_result: A check file at the top level of validation/ targets the file of the same name in validation/ itself, which is how the checks for conftest.py find their target.

name: test_check_passes_when_inventory_is_current
expected_result: With the check option, the run exits 0 and writes nothing when the inventory on disk equals what would be generated.

name: test_quiet_prints_nothing
expected_result: With the quiet option, nothing is printed. The exit code is the whole report.

name: test_check_status_passes_a_superseded_check_with_an_active_successor
expected_result: With the check-status option, a removed check marked superseded, naming an active check that replaced it, passes. The run exits 0 and writes nothing.

name: test_check_status_passes_a_retired_check_with_a_reason
expected_result: With the check-status option, a removed check marked retired, with a reason saying why, passes with exit 0.

name: test_check_fails_when_inventory_is_missing
expected_result: With the check option and no inventory on disk, the run exits 16, names the command to run, and writes nothing.

name: test_check_fails_when_inventory_is_stale
expected_result: With the check option and an inventory that no longer matches the checks, the run exits 16, names the command to run, and leaves the stale inventory as it was.

name: test_check_without_id_exits_18
expected_result: A check with no id label makes the run exit 18 and name the file and the check, and the inventory is not written.

name: test_check_without_objective_exits_18
expected_result: A check with no objective label makes the run exit 18 and name the file and the check, and the inventory is not written.

name: test_check_without_category_exits_18
expected_result: A check with no category label makes the run exit 18 and name the file and the check, and the inventory is not written.

name: test_a_category_not_in_the_list_exits_18
expected_result: A check whose category label names no defined category makes the run exit 18. The message quotes the value and lists the categories.

name: test_an_objective_not_in_the_list_exits_18
expected_result: A check whose objective label names no defined objective makes the run exit 18. The message quotes the value and lists the objectives.

name: test_any_objective_may_carry_a_staged_case
expected_result: A check of any objective may be marked as staging a working or a broken situation, and its row records that, because the mark says how the check was set up.

name: test_a_first_sentence_starting_with_a_refused_character_exits_18
expected_result: A check whose first sentence starts with something other than a letter or a digit makes the run exit 18, and the message names the character and says to start with a letter or a digit. The run is repeated once for each character, the four a spreadsheet reads as the start of a formula, then a bracket and an asterisk.

name: test_a_first_sentence_opening_with_whitespace_is_accepted
expected_result: A check whose docstring opens with a tab or a new line is accepted, and its row holds the sentence without that space, because the generator removes it before looking at the sentence.

name: test_duplicate_id_exits_18
expected_result: Two checks carrying the same id make the run exit 18, and the message names both checks.

name: test_an_id_of_the_wrong_shape_exits_18
expected_result: An id that is not S, a capital letter and five digits makes the run exit 18, and the message names the check and says what an id looks like.

name: test_an_unregistered_suite_exits_18
expected_result: An id whose two letters are not one of the registered suites makes the run exit 18, and the message names the suite and lists the ones that are registered.

name: test_unparseable_file_exits_19
expected_result: A check file that is not valid Python makes the run exit 19, and the message names it.

name: test_no_test_files_exits_20
expected_result: A validation folder with no check files makes the run exit 20. It runs once with an empty validation folder and once with no validation folder at all.

name: test_a_status_not_in_the_list_exits_45
expected_result: A row whose status is not one of the five makes the run exit 45, quoting the status, and the inventory is not rewritten.

name: test_a_status_that_needs_a_reason_without_one_exits_45
expected_result: A check marked pending, inactive or retired with no reason recorded makes the check-status run exit 45 and say the reason is missing. The run is repeated once for each of the three statuses.

name: test_superseded_without_a_successor_exits_45
expected_result: A removed check marked superseded that names no replacing check makes the --check-status run exit 45 and say no check is named.

name: test_a_successor_on_a_check_not_superseded_exits_45
expected_result: A row that names replacing checks while its status is not superseded makes the run exit 45.

name: test_a_status_reason_on_a_check_that_is_not_off_exits_45
expected_result: A row that carries a reason while its status is not pending, inactive or retired makes the run exit 45, because only those three statuses record why a check does not run.

name: test_a_successor_that_is_not_in_the_inventory_exits_45
expected_result: A superseded row that names a replacing check which is not in the inventory makes the check-status run exit 45 and name that check.

name: test_a_version_that_is_not_a_whole_number_exits_45
expected_result: A row whose version is not a whole number from 1 up, such as 1.1, makes the run exit 45, quoting the value.

name: test_a_retired_check_still_in_the_test_files_exits_45
expected_result: A row marked retired whose check is still in the check files makes the run exit 45, saying to remove the check or change its status.

name: test_check_status_without_an_inventory_exits_16
expected_result: With the check-status option and no inventory on disk, the run exits 16 and names the command that writes one.

name: test_a_marker_problem_outranks_a_hand_kept_problem
expected_result: When one check has no objective label and another row has a status not in the list, the run exits 18 and names both problems.

name: test_a_file_with_no_aspect_in_its_name_exits_47
expected_result: A check file whose name ends with no aspect of quality makes the run exit 47, and the message names the file and lists the endings it may take.

name: test_a_check_of_another_aspect_exits_47
expected_result: A check whose objective belongs to another aspect than the one its file is named for makes the run exit 47. The message names the check, its objective, the objective's aspect and the file's aspect.

name: test_the_aspect_is_left_out_of_the_covered_file
expected_result: A check file named test_alpha_conformance.py covers alpha.py, because the aspect at the end of a check file's name is not part of the name of the file it tests.

name: test_a_file_in_an_unlisted_code_folder_exits_48
expected_result: A check file in a code folder the inventory's folder order does not list makes the run exit 48. The message names the file and the folder and says to add the folder to that order.

name: test_check_status_on_a_file_that_will_not_parse_exits_19
expected_result: With the check-status option, a check file that is not valid Python makes the run exit 19 and name the file.

name: test_check_status_on_an_empty_folder_exits_20
expected_result: With the check-status option, a validation folder holding no check files makes the run exit 20 and say no check files were found.

name: test_a_retired_row_is_kept_when_the_inventory_is_regenerated
expected_result: A row marked retired, whose check is no longer in the check files, is kept with its status and reason when the inventory is regenerated.

name: test_a_superseded_row_is_kept_when_the_inventory_is_regenerated
expected_result: A row marked superseded, whose check is no longer in the check files, is kept with the check that replaced it when the inventory is regenerated.

name: test_a_check_file_that_will_not_load_exits_49
expected_result: A check file that is valid Python but fails when it is loaded, because it imports a module that does not exist, makes the run exit 49, and the message names the file and the error.

name: test_a_conftest_that_will_not_load_exits_49
expected_result: A conftest.py in the validation folder that fails when pytest loads it, before any check file is read, makes the run exit 49, and the message names the conftest.py.

name: test_a_check_inside_a_class_exits_51
expected_result: A check written inside a class makes the run exit 51. The message names the file, the class and the check, and says to move the check out of its class.

name: test_a_check_carrying_both_cases_exits_18
expected_result: A check carrying both the positive and the negative label makes the run exit 18, and the message names the check and says to keep the one that is true.

name: test_a_check_that_runs_once_per_value_gets_one_row
expected_result: A check that pytest runs once for each of three values gets one row in the inventory, beside the rows of the other checks in its file.

name: test_runs_of_one_check_with_different_labels_exit_18
expected_result: A check that runs once per value, where one value carries a label the other does not, makes the run exit 18, and the message names the check.

name: test_labels_given_to_the_whole_file_are_read_on_each_check
expected_result: A check whose category and objective are given to every check in its file through the file's pytestmark, and whose id and case are written in full as @pytest.mark labels, gets a row with all four, as a validation report reads them.

name: test_a_check_without_a_docstring_exits_18
expected_result: A check with no docstring makes the run exit 18, and the message names the check and says to write the sentence that must be true for it to pass.

name: test_an_active_row_whose_check_is_gone_exits_45
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, a row marked active whose check has been deleted from its check file makes the run exit 45. The message names the id and says to mark the row retired or superseded, or put the check back.

name: test_a_new_check_given_a_spent_id_exits_45
expected_result: A new check given the id of a check taken out of use makes the run exit 45. The message says the id already belongs to a check of that status and to give the new check the next free id, and offers no other remedy. The run is repeated for a retired check's id and for a superseded check's id.

name: test_a_successor_taken_out_of_use_since_is_accepted
expected_result: A superseded row whose replacing check has itself since been superseded or retired passes the check-status run with exit 0, because a row keeps the check that took over at the time. The run is repeated for a replacing check that was superseded and one that was retired.

name: test_a_row_superseded_by_itself_exits_45
expected_result: A superseded row that names its own id in superseded_by makes the check-status run exit 45, and the message says to name the checks that took over from it.

name: test_a_changed_check_whose_version_did_not_move_exits_50
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, a check whose code changed while its version stayed at 1 makes the run exit 50. The message names the check and its id and says to raise its version to 2.

name: test_a_changed_check_with_a_raised_version_is_accepted
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, a check whose code changed, and whose version was raised by hand from 1 to 2, is accepted, and its new fingerprint is recorded against version 2.

name: test_a_change_to_layout_leaves_the_fingerprint
expected_result: A check whose layout changed, while its code, docstring words and labels did not, keeps its fingerprint, and the run exits 0 with its version still 1. The run is repeated for a change of layout in the code and for a docstring whose words were rewrapped over two lines.

name: test_a_row_without_a_fingerprint_gets_one
expected_result: A row that has no fingerprint recorded yet, as every row had before the column existed, is given one against its version, and the run exits 0.

name: test_a_kept_row_keeps_its_place_by_check_file_and_id
expected_result: A retired row is written among the rows of its own check file, in id order, rather than after the rows of the checks still in use.

name: test_a_row_whose_check_is_gone_is_dropped_when_no_report_is_filed
expected_result: While no validation report has been filed, a row marked active whose check has been deleted from its check file is dropped when the inventory is regenerated, and the run exits 0.

name: test_a_change_to_the_docstring_or_labels_moves_the_fingerprint
expected_result: A check whose docstring or labels changed, while its code did not, gets a new fingerprint. The run is repeated for a reworded docstring, a changed label on the function and a changed label given to the whole check file.

name: test_a_changed_check_is_refingerprinted_when_no_report_is_filed
expected_result: While no validation report has been filed, a check whose code changed while its version stayed at 1 is accepted, the run exits 0, and its new fingerprint is recorded against version 1.

name: test_a_fingerprint_records_the_python_version_that_made_it
expected_result: A check's fingerprint cell records the version it was taken at and then the running Python's major and minor version, such as v1:py3.12: before the sixteen hexadecimal characters.

name: test_fingerprints_made_by_another_python_exit_62
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, an inventory whose fingerprints another Python version made stops the run with exit 62 and one message. The message names both Python versions and says to run build_inventory --python-changed in a commit that changes nothing else.

name: test_python_changed_records_new_fingerprints
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, build_inventory --python-changed records a new fingerprint, made by the running Python, for a row another Python made, without comparing it, and the run exits 0.

name: test_an_empty_fingerprint_exits_63
expected_result: Once a validation report has been filed, a row whose fingerprint cell was emptied makes the run exit 63. The message names the check and its id and says to put its fingerprint back as git last recorded it.

name: test_the_higher_ranked_exit_code_wins
expected_result: When a run finds two problems, it exits with the code the header ranks higher, even when the other problem was found first. It runs once for each pair of codes next to each other in the header's order.

name: test_a_check_inside_a_class_that_runs_once_per_value_is_named_once
expected_result: A check written inside a class that pytest runs once for each of two values is named once in the refusal, not once per value, and the run exits 51.

name: test_a_module_from_outside_the_validation_folder_stays_imported
expected_result: A module that a check file imports while the checks are read, and that lives outside the validation folder, is still imported once the run ends, because whoever imports it gets the same module.

name: test_each_label_is_read_off_a_check_that_carries_it
expected_result: Each label a check carries is read as written. That covers its id, its category, its objective, the aspect of that objective, its case and the fixtures it names.

name: test_a_check_with_no_labels_reads_as_empty
expected_result: A check that carries no label reads as empty for every label, so a missing label shows as a blank rather than stopping the run.

name: test_every_label_is_declared_to_pytest
expected_result: A run that refuses any label pytest has not been told about still collects checks that carry every label between them, the positive and the negative case included, because each one is declared.

name: test_passing_run_is_recorded_as_pass
expected_result: A suite whose tests all pass gets a run's own file saying PASS, with pytest's exit code 0 and its cause.

name: test_a_passing_check_gets_a_row_with_its_details
expected_result: A check that passed gets one row carrying its id, its category, its objective, its staged case, its expected result and the outcome passed. The expected result is the first paragraph of the check's docstring alone, written as one line.

name: test_a_skipped_check_is_shown_as_skipped_with_its_reason
expected_result: A check that was skipped gets a row saying skipped, with the skip's reason and, since it carries no markers, an empty category, objective and staged case.

name: test_a_parametrized_check_gets_one_row_per_value_with_the_value_in_its_own_column
expected_result: A parametrized check gets one row per value, each carrying the function name alone in name, the same as the inventory's, and pytest's id for the value in parameter.

name: test_a_check_without_parameters_has_an_empty_parameter
expected_result: A check that is not parametrized gets an empty parameter column.

name: test_no_flag_writes_nothing
expected_result: Without the report option, a run writes no report at all, so development runs leave no trace.

name: test_cleanup_failure_is_recorded_as_fail
expected_result: A test whose own checks pass but whose clean-up breaks makes pytest exit 1. The report says FAIL, and that test's row says error with the reason clean-up failed.

name: test_a_failure_is_kept_when_the_clean_up_breaks_too
expected_result: A test that fails its own assertion and then breaks in its clean-up keeps both reasons in its row, the assertion message first and the clean-up second, so the later step cannot hide the failure.

name: test_failing_assertion_is_recorded_as_fail
expected_result: A test whose checks fail gives a FAIL report with that row marked failed and the assertion message as its reason.

name: test_setup_failure_is_recorded_as_error
expected_result: A test whose set-up breaks never runs. The report says FAIL and the row says error.

name: test_file_that_will_not_load_still_gets_a_fail_report
expected_result: When a check file cannot even be loaded, no test runs and pytest exits 2. A report is still written, says FAIL and holds one row saying no check ran, so a broken run cannot go unnoticed.

name: test_a_second_report_on_the_same_day_and_commit_gets_a_numbered_name
expected_result: A second report written on the same day at the same commit is given a numbered suffix, and the first report is left exactly as it was.

name: test_run_id_is_the_report_file_name
expected_result: Every row's run id is the report's file name, so a second report on the same day and commit carries its own numbered id and two runs are never confused.

name: test_the_selection_column_records_what_was_selected
expected_result: The selection column records the paths and the keyword and marker filters the command line gave, each under its own entry. It is empty when nothing narrowed the run, and an option that changes only how results are shown adds nothing.

name: test_the_counts_match_when_every_check_ran
expected_result: On a whole run, the collected and reported counts in the run's own file are equal and both count every check, so a reader can see at a glance that nothing was left out.

name: test_a_dropped_check_is_counted_but_not_reported
expected_result: A check dropped before the run started still counts as collected, so a narrowed run shows a gap between the two counts rather than reading as a whole one.

name: test_a_run_that_stops_early_reports_fewer_checks_than_it_collected
expected_result: A run told to stop at the first failure never reaches the checks after it, and its reported count is lower than its collected count, so a run cut short cannot read as a whole one.

name: test_run_by_carries_the_git_user_name
expected_result: The run's own file names the git user who ran it, so a report says who ran it.

name: test_target_file_names_the_mirrored_code_file_and_marks_a_missing_one
expected_result: The target columns name the code file the check file mirrors, by the same rule the inventory uses. When that file is not there its name is marked, so the gap shows.

name: test_a_listing_run_writes_no_report
expected_result: With the collect-only option, the run lists the checks it would run and writes no report, because nothing ran.

name: test_a_report_on_uncommitted_changes_is_refused_before_any_check_runs
expected_result: A report run on a working folder with an uncommitted change stops with exit 4 before any check runs and writes no report. The message names the changed file and says to commit or stash it.

name: test_a_report_on_a_clean_folder_names_its_commit
expected_result: A report run on a working folder that matches its commit goes ahead, and the run's own file records that commit's short id.

name: test_an_earlier_report_not_yet_committed_does_not_count_as_a_change
expected_result: A report already in the reports folder, not yet committed, does not make the working folder dirty, so a second report can be written after the first.

name: test_a_report_asked_of_plain_pytest_is_refused_before_any_check_runs
expected_result: A report asked of plain pytest, with no aspect's command starting the run, stops with exit 4 before any check runs and writes no report. The message says a report comes only from an aspect's command.

name: test_the_runs_own_file_sits_beside_the_report_and_shares_its_run_id
expected_result: Beside each report is the run's own file, named like the report with run added, and its one row carries the same run id as the report's rows, so the two join.

name: test_the_runs_own_file_holds_the_run_columns_in_order
expected_result: The run's own file holds the run's details in this order, with one selection column per way of narrowing a run at the end, so a new way adds a column at the right.

name: test_the_script_under_test_is_recorded_by_its_last_change
expected_result: Each row holds the date and id of the last change in git to the script the check covers, so a report says which version of the script ran.

name: test_the_test_file_is_recorded_by_its_last_change
expected_result: Each row holds the date and id of the last change in git to the check file the check sits in, so a report says which version of the check ran.

name: test_a_named_fixture_is_recorded_on_its_checks_row_only
expected_result: A check that names a fixture has that fixture in its fixtures column, with the date and id of its last change. A check that names none leaves the column empty.

name: test_the_runs_own_file_lists_the_installed_packages
expected_result: The run's own file lists every installed package with its version, so a report says which versions the run used.

name: test_a_second_run_in_the_same_process_reports_on_itself_alone
expected_result: When two runs happen in one process, the second run's own file counts only its own checks, so nothing the first run dropped or ran is carried into it.

name: test_other_aspects_are_not_counted_as_collected
expected_result: On a whole run of an aspect's command, the collected and reported counts are equal, because the checks of other aspects the command drops were never part of what it set out to cover.

name: test_a_report_git_cannot_answer_for_is_refused_before_any_check_runs
expected_result: A report run in a folder where git does not answer stops with exit 4 before any check runs and writes no report. The message says git did not answer and a report needs it.

name: test_a_report_run_emptied_by_a_keyword_filter_is_refused
expected_result: A report run whose keyword filter removes every check stops with exit 4 and writes no report. The message says the filter removed every check and to widen or drop it.

name: test_a_report_run_that_collects_no_check_is_refused
expected_result: A report run given only a check file that holds no check stops with pytest's usage error, exit 4, the message says no checks were collected, and no report is written.

name: test_a_report_folder_outside_the_repo_is_written
expected_result: A report asked for in a folder outside the repository is written there, and the run goes ahead, because a folder outside the repository cannot hold changes to the code being validated.

name: test_a_row_carries_the_version_the_inventory_records
expected_result: A check's row carries the version that validation/validation_inventory.csv records for the check's id.

name: test_a_check_that_runs_once_per_value_counts_once
expected_result: A check that runs once per value counts once in both the collected and the reported counts, as it has one row in the inventory, while each of its runs keeps its own row in the report.

name: test_every_selection_option_reaches_its_own_column
expected_result: Every selection option src/sdgval/select_checks.py defines, given on the command line, is recorded in its own selection column of the run's own file, holding the value given. An option this check has no value for fails it, so a new option cannot be left out.

name: test_a_report_on_a_new_file_is_refused
expected_result: A report run on a working folder holding a new file git does not track yet stops with exit 4 and writes no report. The message names the new file by its full path, even inside a new folder, and says to commit or stash it.

name: test_a_report_on_a_staged_change_is_refused
expected_result: A report run on a working folder whose only change is staged for the next commit stops with exit 4 and writes no report. The message names the staged file and says to commit or stash it.

name: test_two_checks_naming_one_fixture_both_record_it
expected_result: Two checks that name the same fixture both record it with the date and id of its last change, so a file the report has already looked up is recorded again for the next check that names it.

name: test_a_report_is_written_with_pytests_printing_switched_off
expected_result: With pytest's own printing switched off, the report and the run's own file are still written, and the run exits 0 without an error.

name: test_every_group_lists_only_ids_the_inventory_holds
expected_result: Every id each group in validation/validation_groups.yml lists is a check in validation/validation_inventory.csv, so no group names a check that does not exist.

name: test_the_pinned_groups_list_every_check_that_reads_a_pinned_file
expected_result: The pinned_integrity and pinned_conformance groups together list every check that carries the pinned-file label, and the stability check, and nothing else. A new check that reads a pinned file cannot be left out of them.

name: test_the_hook_groups_hold_a_check_for_every_hook_command
expected_result: Every command a step of the real pre-commit hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml runs has at least one check in the hook_integrity or hook_conformance group, so running those groups reproduces every step of the hook.

name: test_category_keeps_only_that_category
expected_result: With the category option, only the checks carrying that category run, and the others get no report row.

name: test_objective_keeps_only_that_objective
expected_result: With the objective option, only the checks carrying that objective run.

name: test_category_and_objective_narrow_each_other
expected_result: With both the category and objective options, only the checks matching both run.

name: test_a_comma_separated_list_means_any_of_the_values
expected_result: A comma-separated list on one option keeps the checks matching any value in it.

name: test_id_keeps_only_those_checks
expected_result: With the id option, only the checks carrying those ids run.

name: test_group_runs_the_ids_the_groups_file_lists
expected_result: With the group option, the checks the named group lists in validation/validation_groups.yml run, and no others.

name: test_the_selection_column_records_the_options
expected_result: The report's selection column records the selection options as given, one entry per option, so a narrowed run cannot pass for a full one.

name: test_a_category_not_in_the_list_stops_the_run
expected_result: A category that is not a defined category stops the run with exit 4 and writes no report, and the message names the value and the categories.

name: test_an_id_no_collected_check_carries_stops_the_run
expected_result: An id that no check has stops the run with exit 4 rather than running nothing. The message says no check has it and where every id is listed.

name: test_a_group_not_in_the_file_stops_the_run
expected_result: A group name that validation/validation_groups.yml does not define stops the run with exit 4, and the message names the groups that do exist.

name: test_group_without_the_groups_file_stops_the_run
expected_result: The group option with validation/validation_groups.yml missing stops the run with exit 4, and the message names the file.

name: test_a_defined_value_matching_no_check_stops_the_run
expected_result: A defined category that no collected check carries stops the run with exit 4 rather than running nothing. The message says the option matched no check and what to do.

name: test_options_that_together_match_nothing_stop_the_run
expected_result: Two options that each match a check, but never the same check, stop the run with exit 4. The message gives each option's own count, so the reader can see which one to change.

name: test_aspect_keeps_only_the_checks_of_that_aspect
expected_result: With the aspect option, only the checks whose objective belongs to that aspect run, although no check carries the aspect itself.

name: test_aspect_and_category_narrow_each_other
expected_result: With both the aspect and category options, only the checks matching both run, so a run can be aimed at one aspect of one kind of thing.

name: test_an_aspect_not_in_the_list_stops_the_run
expected_result: An aspect that is not a defined aspect of quality stops the run with exit 4, and the message names the value and the aspects.

name: test_an_id_outside_the_files_given_stops_the_run
expected_result: An id the inventory lists that is not among the files the run was given stops the run with exit 4. The message says the id is not in the files or folders given.

name: test_a_group_listing_an_id_no_check_has_stops_the_run
expected_result: A group that lists an id no check has stops the run with exit 4. The message names the group and the id and says to correct the groups file.

name: test_an_objective_not_in_the_list_stops_the_run
expected_result: An objective that is not a defined objective stops the run with exit 4, and the message names the value and the objectives.

name: test_a_group_of_mixed_aspects_stops_the_run
expected_result: A group whose checks belong to more than one aspect of quality stops the run with exit 4. The message names the group and its aspects and says to split it into one group per aspect.

name: test_a_group_with_no_list_of_ids_stops_the_run
expected_result: A group that has no list of ids stops the run with exit 4. The message names the group and says to give it an ids list naming at least one check. The run is repeated for an empty list, for a group with no ids at all, and for ids written as one value rather than a list.

name: test_an_option_given_twice_means_any_of_the_values
expected_result: The same option given twice keeps the checks matching either value, the same as a comma-separated list on one option.

name: test_options_that_together_match_nothing_under_plain_pytest_stop_the_run
expected_result: Under plain pytest, with no aspect's command, two options that each match a check, but never the same check, stop the run with exit 4. The message gives each option's own count, so the reader can see which one to change.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_matches_runs
expected_result: A check whose pinned file is on disk and matches its manifest entry runs, and its row says passed.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_changed_is_blocked
expected_result: A check whose pinned file no longer matches its manifest entry is skipped as blocked, naming the file, and the run still passes, because only the stability check for that file fails for the change.

name: test_a_check_whose_pinned_file_is_not_downloaded_is_skipped
expected_result: A check whose pinned file is recorded but not on disk is skipped, and the reason names the file and says to run acquire_sources.

name: test_a_check_naming_a_file_no_manifest_records_errors
expected_result: A check whose pinned-file label names files no manifest records fails at set-up, because the label is a mistake. The run fails, the row says error, and the terminal says to correct the label.

name: test_an_inactive_check_is_skipped_with_its_reason
expected_result: A check the inventory marks inactive is skipped, and its row gives the status and the reason the inventory records, while an active check still runs.

name: test_a_pending_check_is_skipped
expected_result: A check the inventory marks pending is skipped, and its row gives the status and the reason the inventory records.

name: test_a_check_naming_a_fixture_that_is_not_there_errors
expected_result: A check whose fixture label names a file that is not in validation/fixtures/ fails at set-up, because the label is a mistake. The run fails, the row says error, and the terminal names the file and says to correct the label.

name: test_a_second_run_in_one_process_sees_a_pinned_file_that_changed
expected_result: Of two runs in one process, with a pinned file changed between them, the first runs the check that reads the file and the second skips it as blocked, because each run measures the pinned files for itself.

name: test_a_second_file_the_label_names_is_looked_at_too
expected_result: A check whose label names two pinned files, the first in order and the second not downloaded, is skipped, and the reason names the second file.

name: test_every_file_a_pattern_matches_is_looked_at
expected_result: A check whose label is a pattern matching several pinned files, the first in order and a later one changed, is skipped as blocked, naming the changed file.

name: test_the_report_holds_only_the_technical_checks
expected_result: Run on a suite holding technical checks and an integrity check, the command exits 0 and writes a report whose rows are the technical checks alone.

name: test_options_after_the_command_narrow_the_run
expected_result: An option typed after the command, such as the id option, narrows the run the way it narrows pytest, so the report holds only the checks it selects.

name: test_a_run_given_an_aspect_is_refused_before_any_check_runs
expected_result: A run given the aspect option stops with exit 55 before any check runs and writes no report. The message says the command already runs only technical checks.

name: test_the_report_is_named_for_its_aspect
expected_result: The report's file name starts with technical, and every row's run id is that name, so a report copied out of its folder still says which aspect it covers.

name: test_without_the_report_flag_the_checks_run_and_nothing_is_written
expected_result: Without the report option, the command runs the technical checks, exits 0 and writes no report, so a development run leaves no record.

name: test_the_report_is_written_in_the_technical_folder
expected_result: The report and the run's own file are written in a folder named technical inside the report folder, and nothing is written in the report folder itself, so each aspect's reports are kept apart.

name: test_each_way_of_narrowing_the_run_has_its_own_column
expected_result: In the run's own file, each way the run was narrowed has its own selection column, and a way that was not used leaves its column empty.

name: test_options_matching_only_other_aspects_are_refused_plainly
expected_result: Options that match checks, none of them technical, stop the run with exit 56. The message gives how many checks the options match together and says none are technical.

name: test_an_objective_of_another_aspect_is_named_as_such
expected_result: An objective that belongs to another aspect stops the run with exit 56. The message names the aspect it belongs to and lists the technical objectives.

name: test_options_matching_nothing_at_all_give_each_count
expected_result: Options that match no check of any aspect stop the run with exit 56. The message gives each option's own count and never names the aspect the command added.

name: test_several_objectives_of_other_aspects_are_named_together
expected_result: Several objectives that all belong to other aspects stop the run with exit 56. The message names them together as not technical and lists the technical objectives.

name: test_a_failed_check_exits_52
expected_result: A run in which a technical check fails exits 52, the repo's number for one or more checks failing, rather than pytest's own 1.

name: test_an_interrupted_run_exits_53
expected_result: A run stopped part way, as pressing Ctrl+C stops it, exits 53, the repo's number for a run that stopped before every check ran, rather than pytest's own 2.

name: test_a_run_that_collects_no_check_exits_54
expected_result: A run given a check file that holds no check exits 54, the repo's number for no check collected, rather than pytest's own 5 or its usage error. The run is repeated without a report and with one asked for, because the report writer refuses such a run itself.

name: test_a_report_on_uncommitted_changes_exits_57
expected_result: A report run on a working folder with an uncommitted change exits 57, the repo's number for that refusal, rather than pytest's own 4.

name: test_a_report_git_cannot_answer_for_exits_58
expected_result: A report run in a folder where git does not answer exits 58, the repo's number for that refusal, rather than pytest's own 4.

name: test_a_group_of_mixed_aspects_exits_59
expected_result: A group whose checks belong to more than one aspect of quality stops the run with exit 59, the repo's number for that refusal.

name: test_a_group_with_no_ids_exits_60
expected_result: A group that lists no ids stops the run with exit 60, the repo's number for that refusal.

name: test_a_group_listing_an_id_no_check_has_exits_61
expected_result: A group that lists an id no check has stops the run with exit 61, the repo's number for that refusal.

name: test_a_group_without_the_groups_file_exits_13
expected_result: The group option with validation/validation_groups.yml missing stops the run with exit 13, the repo's number for a file that cannot be read.

name: test_an_option_pytest_does_not_know_exits_2
expected_result: A command line pytest refuses, such as one holding an option it does not know, exits 2, the repo's number for an invalid command line, rather than pytest's own 4.

name: test_an_internal_error_in_pytest_exits_1
expected_result: A run in which pytest hits an internal error, because a hook breaks while the checks are collected, exits 1, the repo's number for an unhandled error, rather than pytest's own 3.

name: test_no_other_module_has_a_hooks_name
expected_result: No built-in or standard library module, and no module anywhere else on the import path, has the same name as a hook in .claude/hooks/, so importing the hook by its bare name finds the hook and nothing else. It runs once for each hook, named by its file name without the .py ending.

name: test_an_ordinary_file_is_allowed
expected_result: A file outside inputs/ and manifests/ is allowed, and nothing is printed.

name: test_the_inputs_readme_is_allowed
expected_result: The README.md the project writes into inputs/ itself is allowed.

name: test_a_nested_gitkeep_under_inputs_is_allowed
expected_result: A .gitkeep placeholder anywhere under inputs/ is allowed, since the project writes those itself.

name: test_a_study_manifest_is_allowed
expected_result: A manifest under manifests/study_documents/ is allowed, because the stage that downloads a study will write those.

name: test_the_manifests_readme_is_allowed
expected_result: The README.md at the top of manifests/ is allowed, since only the .json manifests there are hand-written records.

name: test_a_path_outside_the_repo_is_allowed
expected_result: A file outside the repo is allowed, even one under a folder called inputs/, because the hook guards this repo's pinned files and nothing else.

name: test_the_project_dir_outranks_the_message_cwd
expected_result: A path under another folder's inputs/ is allowed when the session has moved into that folder, so the message's cwd is not what the hook takes as the repo root.

name: test_the_message_cwd_is_used_when_the_variable_is_absent
expected_result: Without the project folder setting, the folder the message was sent from stands in as the repo root.

name: test_a_malformed_message_is_allowed
expected_result: A message that is not the kind Claude Code sends is allowed, with nothing printed, so a malformed message can never block ordinary work.

name: test_a_message_without_a_path_is_allowed
expected_result: A well-formed message that names no file path is allowed, since there is nothing to judge.

name: test_a_refusal_is_printed_in_the_form_claude_code_reads
expected_result: A refusal is printed in the form Claude Code reads, as a decision to deny with a reason, and the exit code stays 0.

name: test_a_pinned_file_is_refused_from_another_folder
expected_result: A file under the real repo's inputs/ is refused even when the message says the session has moved into another folder, so the root really is the project folder and not the current one.

name: test_a_pinned_file_is_refused
expected_result: A file directly under inputs/ is refused, and the reason names the path and says such files arrive through acquire_sources.

name: test_a_nested_pinned_file_is_refused
expected_result: A file deep under inputs/ is refused the same as one at the top, because the rule is the folder and not a list.

name: test_a_hand_written_manifest_is_refused
expected_result: A .json manifest at the top of manifests/ is refused, and the reason says a re-pin is recorded in DECISIONS.md and made by a person.

name: test_a_relative_path_is_judged_against_the_repo_root
expected_result: A repo-relative path is resolved against the repo root before it is judged, so writing inputs/x.pdf without a folder in front is still refused.

name: test_the_repo_root_itself_is_allowed
expected_result: A path that is the repo root itself names no pinned file, so it is allowed and nothing is printed.
